limitations: Native LOD/frame callbacks run during GPU-suppressed warmup, stock XR camera/matrix updates retained, then three genuine full frames before capture. No real-time performance inferred from warmup.

Camera matching is baseline versus correction within each modality; desktop and XR use their existing distinct FOVs. Near XR viewer pose derives from Explore; normal/farther are physical viewer emulation. No production camera edits.
Only native software-rendered frames; actual Quest stereo, lighting, comfort and text legibility remain hardware review.
